articles.title: Where to watch Steelers - Jets live online and what time is the game?
articles.standfirst: Pittsburgh continue their preparation for the 2026 - 2027 season
articles.summary: Pittsburgh continue their preparation for the 2026 - 2027 season
articles.body:
The third week of the NFL preseason continues, and the Steelers are still fine-tuning pieces before the real action begins . When the Pittsburgh Steelers host the New York Jets, neither team will be playing to win a title, but rather to address roster questions, evaluate the players fighting for a spot on the roster, and give rhythm to the units that are still taking shape.

Without a doubt, this is August American football, with all the uncertainty and value opportunities for each team preparing for the 2026-2027 NFL season

How are the Steelers and Jets coming into their preseason matchup?

We are facing a preseason matchup, not a regular-season game, and that completely changes how it should be analyzed. In these contests, starters usually see limited action —sometimes just one offensive series, sometimes none at all—while the bulk of the minutes falls to backups, rookies, and players on the roster bubble.

The result matters less than the rotations, and that is why it is advisable to treat each betting line with caution: the depth of the bench and the coaching staff's decisions about who plays and how much carry more weight than any historical hierarchy between the franchises.

For the Steelers , playing at home always adds a sense of pride , although in the preseason the home-field advantage fades. For the Jets, it is another stop on the August tour to fine-tune details before the official kickoff. Both arrive with the same goal: to come out healthy and with answers.

Steelers - Jets: What time do they play and where can you watch the game live?

The kickoff of the Steelers - Jets matchup is scheduled for this Friday, August 21, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. Eastern Time . In the rest of the United States, the game's start times will be:

The setting for the matchup between Pittsburgh and New York will be Acrisure Stadium, in the city of Pittsburgh, United States, a venue with a capacity of 68,400 spectators. The Steelers are the home team in a game corresponding to the 2026 NFL preseason .

Coverage of this game and the entire NFL around the world will be available through NFL Game Pass International via DAZN. For the United States, you can watch the live broadcast on NFL Network and WCBS.

How is the betting market looking in the preseason and for the Steelers - Jets game?

At the moment there are no published lines for this matchup—the betting market usually opens these August games with little advance notice and low depth—, so instead of quoting prices that do not exist, it is worth explaining how these matchups have historically behaved and what to look for when the odds appear.

The first rule in preseason: the moneyline is a coin flip on steroids. Without established starters for the full 60 minutes, favoritism is built more on roster depth and on which backup quarterback gets more minutes than on the franchise name.

It is advisable to wait to learn each coaching staff's rotation plans —how many series the starters will play, who will run the offense in the second half—before committing a pick on the winner.

In all cases, the discipline is the same: wait for confirmation of the rotations before making any move . In the preseason, information about who is playing is worth more than any prior analysis.

articles.title: Aaron Rodgers gets ‘attacked’ by Cameron Heyward and Steelers veteran on the sidelines
articles.summary: Veteran quarterback Aaron Rodgers is getting ready for his 22nd season in the NFL, and Friday night showed just how much he’s loved and respected as a player during the Pittsburgh Steelers 17-0 loss to the New York Jets.
articles.body:
Veteran quarterback Aaron Rodgers is getting ready for his 22nd season in the NFL, and Friday night showed just how much he’s loved and respected as a player during the Pittsburgh Steelers 17-0 loss to the New York Jets.

During the game, veteran leader Cameron Heyward approached Rodgers and started to ‘attack’ him in a friendly way, with some veterans joining in the fun.

Even though the Steelers lost, Pittsburgh is confident that Rodgers can take them far in his last NFL season. Will he deliver? Only time will tell..
